current.text: His role in the Spurs offense is reduced. He is not a high-usage player there.
He is a fixed part of the Spurs rotation. He showed defense and shot blocking in the postseason.

Experts disagree on whether he starts. The August Spurs preview lists him as a starter next to Fox, Castle, Harris and Wembanyama. Newer notes say the lineup is unclear and Dylan Harper may start next to Castle and Fox. Tobias Harris has a calf strain.
Not projected to be draftable because of the Spurs' depth. The crowded roster limits fringe players.
The Spurs are very deep at forward. Experts expect them to consolidate through trades in the near future, but not right now.
The Spurs are projected as a top team in the West. One expert predicts 63 wins.

durable.text: He is an all-around wing. He scores, shoots threes, rebounds, defends and works as a secondary playmaker.

note: He costs about 1 USD on Yahoo (rank 163) and 0.4 USD on ESPN (rank 130), after going for 5 USD in our league last season. His projections help in threes (+0.9 z) and turnovers (+0.7 z) but hurt FG% (-0.7 z), and his shot volume has dropped to about 11 attempts per game. That makes him a last-round bench pick or a waiver option, not a draft target. Early in the season, check whether he keeps a starting spot as Harper, Harris and Champagnie compete for minutes.
